_doc: THE single source of truth for parametric T1 defaults and preferences.
Edit this file to change behaviour; do not edit source. Nothing in python/ carries a
fallback value, so any key absent from here and from your run config is an error.
Resolution order, highest first:
1. your run config
2. this file's 'defaults' block
3. error
This file holds preferences only. The inputs a run operates on -- output_dir,
vfa_files, mask_file, b1_map_file -- belong in a run config, not here, because they
describe one study rather than how the software behaves. See
python/parametric_run_example.json for a runnable config.
Sections:
'defaults' -- key -> value. These are the values a run uses unless overridden.
'required' -- known keys with NO default. Supply one or the run stops. The text
explains where the value should come from.
'optional' -- known keys with no default where being absent is meaningful (a
fallback mechanism or auto-detection takes over). Not an error.
'_units'   -- the unit each physical key is expressed in. Advisory, not parsed.
A key in none of these sections is rejected as unknown, so typos are caught rather
than silently ignored.

required.output_dir: Where the run writes its maps, summary and figures. Set this in your run config.

optional.tr_ms: Repetition time. Read from the VFA image's JSON sidecar when absent, which is where dce2bids writes it. Set it here only if your sidecars do not carry it.
optional.flip_angles_deg: One angle per flip frame of the VFA image. Read from the per-flip JSON sidecars when absent. Must describe the frames of the image actually being fitted.
optional.mask_file: Restrict fitting to a mask. Every voxel is fitted when absent.
optional.b1_map_file: B1 correction map. Flip angles are used as nominal when absent.
